search.description: Search characters by name, type (player/npc/other), approval status, campaign setting, or owning player — use this to find a specific character sheet or list who's approved for play in a setting.

get.description: Get a single character's full sheet: stats, skills, items, conditions, and event history.

create.description: Create a new draft character (defaults to type=player, approved=no) — the assistant-assisted 'help me build a character' flow. The character is not usable in play until a game master runs the existing approval transition.

search.description: Search players by name or linked Nextcloud user id — use this to find who controls a given character.

get.description: Get a single player's profile and description.

search.description: Search LARP settings (worlds/campaigns) by name or status (active/archived) — use this to see which campaigns are currently running versus finished.

get.description: Get a single setting's detail — the campaign that scopes its characters, events, and rules.

search.description: Search purchasable skills by name or campaign setting — use this to look up what a skill does or what's available to buy with experience points.

get.description: Get a single skill's prerequisites (required skills, stats, conditions, effects) and the effects it grants.

search.description: Search magical/special items by name, uniqueness, or campaign setting.

get.description: Get a single item's granted effects and which characters currently hold it.

search.description: Search gameplay conditions (consequences applied to characters) by name, uniqueness, or campaign setting.

get.description: Get a single condition's granted effects and which characters currently carry it.

search.description: Search LARP events by name, campaign setting, or location — use this to find upcoming or past gatherings.

get.description: Get a single event's schedule, location, and subscribed players.

search.description: Search experience-point awards by event or character — use this to see a character's XP history or everyone awarded XP at a given event.

get.description: Get a single XP award's amount, reason, and awarding game master.

create.description: Record a single experience-point award for one character at one event — the post-event 'award XP to each attendee' ritual this schema exists for. Purely additive audit data; OpenRegister authorization restricts this write to the gamemasters group regardless of who calls it via MCP.

search.description: Search event attendance/check-in records by event, character, or status (registered/checked-in/no-show).

get.description: Get a single attendance record's status and check-in timestamp.

update.description: Move a participant's day-of attendance status forward at check-in (registered to checked-in, or to no-show). The record itself is created when the character signs up for the event; this only advances its status. checkedInAt/checkedInBy are always server-stamped and cannot be set by this call. OpenRegister authorization restricts this write to the gamemasters group.
